title: Moraine Lake, Lake Louise, Peyto & Bow Lake Small-Group Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the Canadian Rockies with Monarc VIP Tours, where comfort, personalized service, and unforgettable scenery come together. Your small-group experience is designed to maximize your time at each destination while avoiding the rushed feeling of larger coach tours. Travel in a modern, comfortable vehicle with friendly local guides who know the Rockies inside and out, making your journey as memorable as the destinations themselves. From the turquoise waters of Moraine Lake and Lake Louise to the spectacular viewpoints along the Icefields Parkway, every stop has been carefully selected to showcase the very best of Banff National Park.
